page.tagline: Find power trails in your Pocket Queries and walk them

empty.title: Find the best power trails near you
empty.lead: A power trail is a chain of quick caches a short walk apart. PowerTrailBuddy finds them in your own Pocket Query and guides you from cache to cache.

step1.title: Create a Pocket Query
step1.text: On geocaching.com (Premium): pick an area, Traditional caches, up to 1000 results, and tick “I haven't found” and “Is enabled”.

step2.title: Download the .zip
step2.text: Download it from the Pocket Query page, or open it straight from the e-mail you get.

step3.title: Import it here
step3.text: Pick the .zip or .gpx below. On Android, once the app is installed, you can also share the file to PowerTrailBuddy.
